decisions.question: SPEC 0295 (PAR-S05, query and trace of sessions), reviewed by the Codex (R2 'ready for your decision', sha c608dc6d…). Recommended: D1 list ordered by the existing writer key with live paging and filters on header metadata, no migration (becomes an index migration automatically if the slice-2 EXPLAIN shows unbounded reads); D2 list/trace show only metadata and references, no payload; D3 sessions without a header are skipped and counted; D4 the cursor is an unauthenticated position hint bound to version/filter/tenant (tampering only moves where your own list starts; a MAC cursor only if you want tamper detection); D5 trace goes one hop, returns ambiguity instead of guessing, with global budgets (note: up to 100 events of up to 1 MiB each may be held in memory per page, so the 4 MiB limit is on examined data, not on RAM); D6 keep the v1 event catalogue; D7 additive SDK methods in protocol v1; D8 the host decides access by role for now (roles come with S06). Approve as recommended?
